topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Well, would you look at that! Found a good haul up in the attic, did you? Must feel like finding a silver coin in the midden on St. Patrick's Day. Those old chests might be heavy, but who knows what treasures they hold under all that dust? I recall when old Thomas Downfield dug up his father's old coin purse, thought he was the king of the harvest for a week! Be sure to take your time, sort through everything with care. You never know, some of those old things might fetch a fine price at the market, or maybe even the lord's manor would have need of them. A pleasant surprise, that's for sure.
